notes: Per-level data is keyed by level as a string, "1" to "20".
Text is ASCII: curly apostrophes and quotes became straight ones; an em dash (none) became an empty feature list, a null column value or a 0 slot count.
SRD 5.2.1 gives every caster a fixed Prepared Spells count per level; it has no spells-known lists and no preparation formulas.
Paladin and Ranger gain Spellcasting at level 1 in SRD 5.2.1, with two level 1 slots.
Ability Score Improvement levels are 4, 8, 12 and 16 for every class, plus 6 and 14 for Fighter and 10 for Rogue. Level 19 grants Epic Boon (a feat), not an Ability Score Improvement.
No SRD 5.2.1 class is a third caster; caster_kind third is unused.
Subclass features appear as the SRD's 'Subclass feature' entry; subclass tables are not included.
table_columns holds the class table's other columns (for example Rages or Sneak Attack) exactly as printed.

srd-progression/2 (NUM): classes.<class>.use_pools lists every class feature (not subclass) whose uses are counted and restored by a rest: maximum is {column} (the class table), {fixed}, {by_level}, {ability_modifier, minimum} or {class_level_times}; refresh is a list of steps from a class level, short_rest and long_rest each one, all or null. use_pools_not_modeled names the three whose limits are not a count. ac_formulas: unarmored base Armor Class features. hp_bonuses: typed Hit Point maximum increases (SRD 5.2.1 has no Tough feat). table_names (keyword validation V4): the class table rows printed for a pool's feature ("Action Surge (one use)"), each matched as a whole name.

srd-progression/2 (R2): classes.<class>.feature_activation, for fighter and rogue (every class feature except Ability Score Improvement, Epic Boon and the subclass entries), records how the SRD says the feature is used: activation is bonusAction, action, magicAction, reaction, noAction (used or triggered without taking an action) or passive, with the SRD sentence that says so (evidence) and its source section and page. Other classes have no feature_activation yet. table_names as in use_pools.
